episodes.title: Was I born into a cult this entire time? (Growing up 2x2)
episodes.description:
How do you describe being born and raised in a religion so secretive that it has no official name, no church buildings, and no public figurehead?
The Truth (as members call it) is stranger than fiction. And I tell it with spicy humour. And a naughty story or two.
Using https://www.tellingthetruth.info/home/factsheet.php as a factual reference point, I cover the basics of the 2x2 religious community while sharing candid details of my own childhood and the experiences that shaped my first 25 years, until I officially left.
While my story is not one of abuse, leaving a community that has been part of your entire existence comes with its own struggles. I share some of the challenges I still experience and how I navigate and enjoy my life beyond “the Way.”
This episode is the length of a movie, and there will be a sequel or two.
